rows.note: This is the all-purpose casual way to mean the place where someone works.

example.english: The workplace where I work is close to the MTR station.
example.jyutping: ngo5 faan1 gung1 go2 dou6 gan6 dei6 tit3 zaam6

rows.note: Use this when specifying a work location, especially in official descriptions or job listings.

example.jyutping: ceng2 tin4 se2 gung1 zok3 dei6 dim2

rows.note: Use this when the workplace is specifically an office rather than another kind of work site.

example.english: Our workplace is moving to Kowloon next month.
example.traditional: 我哋辦公室下個月搬去九龍。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 baan6 gung1 sat1 haa6 go3 jyut6 bun1 heoi3 gau2 lung4

rows.note: Use this for the professional workplace as an environment or social sphere, rather than simply its physical location.

example.english: In the workplace, sometimes it’s about ability, not age.
example.traditional: 職場上有時講實力，唔係講年紀。
example.jyutping: zik1 coeng4 soeng6 jau5 si4 gong2 sat6 lik6 m4 hai6 gong2 nin4 gei2
